# ankra_alert_destinations (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's alert destinations, every page of them. Webhook URLs are left out because they carry secrets. The counterpart of `ankra alerts destinations list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_alert_destinations" "all" {}

output "destination_ids" {
  value = { for destination in data.ankra_alert_destinations.all.destinations : destination.name => destination.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `destinations` (Attributes List) Destinations, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `channel_id` (String) Channel the Ankra bot posts to; null for a webhook destination.
- `channel_name` (String) Display name of the channel.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether alerts are delivered.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the destination.
- `integration_type` (String) Receiver kind.
- `name` (String) Destination name.
- `teams_tenant_id` (String) Teams tenant of a Teams channel destination.
